title: Squarespace Developer Platform: APIs, Apps, and Docs
snippet:
The Squarespace MCP server is a remote server: your client connects to it over HTTPS, and there's nothing to install. In Gemini, Squarespace is already built in. For Claude, ChatGPT, and other clients, you add it with the server URL.
## Gemini
Squarespace is built into Gemini as one of its [connected apps](https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13695044), so there's no server URL to enter.
1. On [gemini.google.com](https://gemini.google.com), open **Customize** in the sidebar, then **Connectors**.
2. Find **Squarespace** and click **Add**.
3. In a chat, type `@Squarespace` or just ask for a domain.
Gemini offers Squarespace to personal Google accounts in the US, in English, on the web, mobile, and Windows apps. Only the [Domains](/mcp/tools/domains) tools are available in Gemini.
## Server URL
```
Codehttps://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp
```
Use this URL in Claude, ChatGPT, and any other MCP client. Menu names in each client change between releases, so the steps below may not match your version exactly.
## Claude
1. Open **Settings → Connectors** and choose to add a custom connector.
2. Enter `https://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp` as the server URL.
3. To use the Commerce tools, connect and [sign in to Squarespace](/mcp/connect-a-client#sign-in-to-squarespace) when prompted.
4. Start a new chat with the connector turned on.
## Claude Code
Add the server from your terminal:
```
Codeclaude mcp add --transport http squarespace https://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp
```
Then run `/mcp` in Claude Code and choose the Squarespace server to sign in.
## ChatGPT
1. Open **Settings → Apps & Connectors** (or **Connectors**, depending on your plan and version).
2. Add a custom connector with the URL `https://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp`.
3. Sign in to Squarespace when prompted if you want to use the Commerce tools.
4. Turn the connector on for a new chat.
## Any other MCP client
Configure a remote MCP server with:
- **URL:** `https://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp`
- **Transport:** Streamable HTTP
Only the [Domains](/mcp/tools/domains) tools are available in other clients. The Commerce tools are currently only available in Claude and ChatGPT.
## Sign in to Squarespace
The [Domains](/mcp/tools/domains) tools work without an account. The [Commerce](/mcp/tools/commerce) tools need you to sign in with the Squarespace account you use to manage your websites, and are currently only available in Claude and ChatGPT.
When your client offers to connect or sign in, you're taken to the standard Squarespace

title: Connect Squarespace to an AI assistant
snippet:
To connect Squarespace:
1. In your AI assistant, open the settings for connectors, apps, plugins, or integrations.
2. Search for *Squarespace*. If Squarespace isn’t listed, add a custom connector and enter this URL: https://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp
3. Click **Connect**, then follow the prompts.

title: raw.githubusercontent.com/api-evangelist/squarespace/refs/heads/main/mcp/squarespace-mcp.yml
snippet:
name: Squarespace MCP Server
status: live
description: >-
Squarespace operates a first-party REMOTE MCP server at https://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp. It
answers an unauthenticated JSON-RPC tools/list with HTTP 200 and returns two real tools with full
JSON Schema inputSchemas. The tool list was captured verbatim to mcp/squarespace-mcp-tools.json on
2026-08-13. Note what it is and is not: this server exposes the DOMAIN acquisition funnel — domain
search and brand-name generation — not the Commerce APIs. None of the 55 published Commerce
operations (orders, products, inventory, contacts, discounts, transactions, webhooks) are reachable
through it. It is a customer-acquisition surface an agent can call on an end user's behalf, not an
agent interface to a merchant's store.
deployment:
mode: remote
endpoint: https://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp
transport: streamable-http
auth: none
verified: probed
probed: '2026-08-13'
http_status: 200
install: null
package: null
note: >-
No first-party stdio package is published — there is no @squarespace/mcp on npm and no install
command in Squarespace's docs. The only shipped surface is the hosted URL, which an MCP client
can POST to right now with no credential.
server:
url: https://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp
protocol: MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP
content_type: application/json
accept: 'application/json, text/event-stream'
edge: Cloudflare (cf-ray observed on the response)
authentication:
required: false
oauth_discovery:
'/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server': 404
'/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource': 404
note: >-
Anonymous tools/list succeeds, and neither MCP OAuth discovery document is served. There is no
published path to authenticate to this server, which is consistent with it exposing only
public catalog data.

An agent that needs to read a merchant's orders or adjust inventory must call the REST API
directly with a bearer token; there is no Squarespace-operated MCP path to it.
crosswalk: mcp/squarespace-tool-crosswalk.yml
third_party_servers:
- name: '@florasync/squarespace-mcp'
registry: npm
version: 0.1.0
published: '2026-07-26'
official: false
repository: https://github.com/FloraSync/squarespace-mcp
note: >-
Third-party, not Squarespace-published. Recorded for completeness only; not wired as a
Squarespace agent surface.
